answer: In a PoA marketplace, each agent must stake a unique cryptographic token forged in a decentralized enclave that records a timestamped proof of physical‑world attestation, such as planting a yarrow seed and broadcasting the growth curve to the dune‑wide gossip layer. Periodically a randomly chosen jury of validators audits a subset of these proofs, recomputing the growth hash and revoking any token whose signature deviates.
